title: 开给家人的路
logline: 深夜电台女主播方晚连线二十年驾龄的出租车司机陈国平，借电波传递家人牵挂，传递「有些路是开给家里人听的」的温情主张，落地耐用车载好物推荐。

shots.visual: A realistic late-night radio studio with soundproof cotton walls, a mixing console, a warm desk lamp and a pop filter; host Fang Wan in a dark red shirt with a silver clip on her shoulder-length black hair, wearing monitoring headphones, presses the answer button on the console.

lines.zh: 您好，这里是深夜伴你行电台，我是方晚。
lines.en: Hello, this is Late Night Companion Radio, I'm Fang Wan.

shots.ttsDirection: 沉静温软，语速偏慢，气息轻缓，重音落在『深夜』『电台』上，带电台主播特有的安抚质感

shots.visual: A realistic taxi driver's seat at night, with faint road lights sweeping across, hanging decorations swaying slightly, wipers off and dashboard glowing; driver Chen Guoping in a dark blue work jacket with short gray hair and stubble, holding the steering wheel, an old towel draped over it.

lines.zh: 我开了二十年车，今晚最想哭。
lines.en: I've been driving for 20 years, and I feel like crying tonight.

shots.ttsDirection: 情绪压抑带哽咽前感，语速偏慢，气息发沉，重音落在『二十年』『最想哭』上，像强忍情绪的状态

shots.visual: Close-up of Fang Wan in the radio studio, leaning towards the pop filter, the warm light falling on her focused face.

lines.zh: 是遇到什么难事了吗？慢慢说。
lines.en: Did you run into any trouble? Take your time.

shots.ttsDirection: 共情柔和，语速平稳，气息稳而轻，重音落在接话的回应词上，带凑近话筒的纵深感

shots.visual: Inside the taxi, faint road lights sweep across Chen Guoping's face, he raises his hand to wipe his eyes, the old towel on the steering wheel sways slightly with the car's movement.

lines.zh: 女儿考上了大学，我却在两百公里外跑车。
lines.en: My daughter got into college, but I'm driving 200 kilometers away.

shots.ttsDirection: 情绪绷不住带颤音，语速偏慢，气息发颤，重音落在『两百公里』『跑车』上，像强忍泪意的哽咽感

shots.narrationZh: 凌晨两点的电波，连着两个牵挂家的人。
shots.narrationEn: At 2 a.m., the radio wave connects two people who care about their families.
shots.visual: Split screen: on the left is Fang Wan in the studio holding the microphone with a gentle look, on the right is Chen Guoping's side profile looking out of the taxi window, with faint radio wave light floating in the middle.
shots.ttsDirection: 情绪温润有连接感，语速平稳，气息连贯，重音落在『凌晨两点』『连着』上，带电波传递的暖意

shots.narrationZh: 有些路，是开给家里人听的，耐用的车载好物，陪每段归路。
shots.narrationEn: Some roads are driven for family. Durable car accessories accompany every journey home.
shots.visual: Close-up of the old towel on the taxi steering wheel, next to a pack of the same durable car towel with the brand logo, implying product promotion.
shots.ttsDirection: 情绪温软收束，语速放缓，气息柔缓，重音落在『家里人』『归路』上，带踏实的安全感
